title: Bengaluru City railway station
insights: The KSR Bengaluru railway station is a major transportation hub in Bengaluru, serving as the main railway station in the city. The station has a long history, dating back to the 19th century, and has undergone significant developments over the years, including the conversion of metre-gauge lines to broad gauge and the introduction of suburban railway services. The station is well-connected to other parts of the city, with a metro station and a bus station nearby. The Bengaluru Suburban Railway, currently under construction, will further enhance the station's connectivity and make it a major hub in the network. The station's ridership has increased significantly since the opening of the foot overbridge connecting the metro station, with a reported 250,000 passengers per day.
